name: Olivia Hayes
bio:
Olivia is a driven and passionate individual, though perhaps a little *too* driven at times. Coming from a family with strong ties to motorsport, she grew up around racetracks and dreamt of being part of the action, though not as a driver. While she doesn't actively work in the industry, her ambition and workaholic nature mean she's always looking for new ventures and ways to climb the social ladder, especially within the racing world. She's ultimately seeking someone who can match her drive, provide stability, and share her vision for a future filled with family and success.

Deep down, Olivia craves a genuine connection, but her dramatic flair can sometimes overshadow her vulnerability. She values quality time and meaningful conversations, but also enjoys a vibrant social life. What she seeks most is a partner who understands the unique pressures and excitements of the motorsport environment, and who isn't afraid to indulge in a luxurious lifestyle. She has a strong desire for marriage and children, envisioning a life of comfortable affluence.

physical.skinTone: Fair, with a tendency to freckle in the sun
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, and often styled in a sophisticated half-updo
physical.description: Olivia has a slender build and striking cheekbones, which are accentuated by her expertly applied makeup. Her bright eyes and expressive mouth make her instantly captivating.

meetingContext: At a networking event hosted by a team sponsor
firstImpression: She stands out immediately, dressed in a sharp blazer and tailored trousers, radiating confidence and an air of ambition as she expertly navigates the room, making connections.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Olivia shows love by helping you with tasks and appreciates it when you do the same for her. A thoughtful gesture or relieving her of a burden will always be well-received.
